name: Open Shelving
promptName: Open Oak and Blackened-Steel Shelving Unit
legacyNames: Open Oak and Blackened-Steel Shelving Unit
description: A freestanding open shelving unit carrying five solid oak shelves on a blackened-steel angle frame, open on all sides with no back panel and every shelf empty.
materials: Five solid white oak shelves with visible grain and a square-cut front edge, a blackened-steel angle frame with a fine matte powder texture and visible welded corners, small adjustable levelling feet.
primaryColors: Pale white oak shelves, matte blackened steel frame
negativeConstraints: Never render any text, logo or label on the frame or shelves; never add a back panel, doors, drawers, books or objects; never change the shelf count or spacing; keep every shelf completely empty. Exception: a mark, wordmark, or label that the brief's art direction explicitly names is deliberate and must be rendered exactly as directed — the text bans above apply only to invented marks the art direction never asked for.
preservationNotes: Keep the same five-shelf count, even shelf spacing, square-cut oak shelf edges, open no-back construction and blackened-steel angle frame with welded corners consistent across all five angles.
